importer.heading: Imports
importer.description: Bring work items from other tools into this workspace.
importer.no_access: Only workspace admins and project admins can import work items.

jira.title: Import from Jira
jira.description: Upload a CSV export from Jira. Statuses, sprints, epics, people, comments and links are mapped for you to review.

history.title: Previous imports
history.errors: {count, plural, one {# row could not be imported} other {# rows could not be imported}}
history.empty_description: Imports you run will be listed here with their progress and results.

toast.load_failed: The import could not be loaded

errors.missing_file: Choose a CSV file exported from Jira.
errors.invalid_type: The file must be a CSV export from Jira.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than the {size} MB upload limit.
errors.invalid_encoding: The file's text encoding could not be read. Export it again as CSV.
errors.invalid_csv: The file is not a valid CSV file.
errors.missing_columns: This doesn't look like a Jira export. It needs the Issue key and Summary columns.
errors.no_work_items: The file has no work items.
errors.storage_failed: The file could not be stored. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.not_undoable: Only finished imports can be undone.
errors.invalid_jira_project: Choose a Jira project from the file.
errors.missing_target: Choose where to import the work items.
errors.invalid_name: Enter a project name without special characters.
errors.name_taken: A project with this name already exists.
errors.identifier_length: The identifier must be 1 to 12 characters.
errors.identifier_invalid: The identifier can only contain letters and numbers.
errors.identifier_taken: This identifier is already used by another project.
errors.invalid_state: One of the chosen states no longer exists. Review the status mapping.
errors.invalid_member: One of the chosen people is no longer a workspace member. Review the people mapping.

undo.title: Undo this import?
undo.description: Everything this import created in {project} will be removed. Work items that existed before are kept.
undo.description_project: The project {project} was created by this import and will be removed with everything in it.

delete.title: Remove from history?
delete.description: The uploaded file and this entry are removed. Imported work items are kept.

upload.drop_title: Drop a Jira CSV file here, or click to choose one
upload.how_step_1: In Jira, open Filters and search for the work items you want to move, for example project = ALMS.
upload.how_step_2: Choose Export, then Export CSV (all fields).
upload.how_step_3: Upload the downloaded file here. Nothing is imported until you review the mapping.

target.new_project_hint: Recommended. Jira keys are kept as they are.
target.new_project_admin_only: Only workspace admins can create projects.
target.existing_project_hint: Add the work items to a project you administer.
target.identifier_taken: {identifier} is already used in this workspace. Choose another identifier.
target.keys_kept: Jira keys are kept, so ALMS-12 stays ALMS-12.
target.keys_renumbered: This project already has work items, so imported items get new numbers. Each one shows its Jira key in its description.

warnings.multiple_projects: The file contains more than one Jira project. Only the chosen project is imported.
warnings.duplicate_keys: Some Jira keys appear more than once. Each repeated key is imported once.
warnings.unparsed_dates: {count, plural, one {# date could not be read and will be left empty.} other {# dates could not be read and will be left empty.}}

mapping.statuses_hint: Choose the state each Jira status becomes. New states are created in the group you pick.

people.hint: People are matched to workspace members by name. Unmatched people are left unassigned, and their names are kept on the work item.
people.none: No people were found in the file.

keep_keys.title: Keep Jira keys
keep_keys.description: Imported items keep their Jira numbers.

sprints_as_cycles.title: Sprints become cycles
sprints_as_cycles.description: Cycle dates are inferred from the items in each sprint.

epics_as_modules.title: Epics become modules
epics_as_modules.description: Items in an epic are added to its module.

issue_types_as_labels.title: Issue types become labels
issue_types_as_labels.description: Task, Bug, Story and other types are added as labels.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Comments keep their original date and author.

attachments.title: Attachments as links
attachments.description: Attachments are linked to Jira. Opening them still needs Jira access.

watchers.title: Watchers become subscribers
watchers.description: Mapped watchers follow the work item.

on_existing.title: Items imported before
on_existing.description: When this file is imported again, items already imported are updated or skipped.

review.title: What happens next
review.work_items: {count, plural, one {# work item is imported.} other {# work items are imported.}}
review.new_states: {count, plural, one {# new state is created.} other {# new states are created.}}
review.cycles: {count, plural, one {# cycle is created from sprints.} other {# cycles are created from sprints.}}
review.unmapped: {count, plural, one {# person is not mapped and is left unassigned.} other {# people are not mapped and are left unassigned.}}
review.rerun: Items imported earlier are matched by their Jira id, so nothing is duplicated.
review.silent: No notifications or emails are sent. You can undo the import afterwards.

progress.running_hint: You can close this window. The import continues in the background.
progress.done_hint: Review the results below. You can undo the import from the Imports page.
